permissions.orders:read:own: read orders the user is linked to; the link is the orders service's audited grant row
permissions.orders:create:any: create an order directly (staff intake) or by lead conversion
permissions.orders:grant:any: link or unlink a customer to an order
permissions.documents:upload:own: upload to an order the user is linked to
permissions.documents:upload:any: upload on a customer's behalf (walk-in paper)
permissions.documents:download:own: download documents of an order the user is linked to
permissions.documents:review:any: add or waive requirements, review versions
permissions.leads:assign:self: assign a lead to oneself: the target assignee must equal the principal's user id (`:self`)
permissions.leads:assign:any: assign a lead to any member
permissions.leads:convert:any: convert to order and cancel conversion
